data.narrative:
Kela is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised $100M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing—all operating in the same sector and developmental stage.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $100M total raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-round transitions, implying a valuation of $200M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—yielding a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $170M to $460M, with a median of $300M. The wide dispersion between peer valuations ($125M–$4.0B) reflects material variance in either company maturity, customer traction, or investor conviction within the defense technology subsector. Key uncertainties include the comparability of peer revenue multiples, customer concentration risk, and regulatory barriers to growth that may differentiate Kela's trajectory from the broader cohort.
